messages:
maya: Quick run-through on the Compliance panel: retention chip shows '90d' and a tiny sparkline. Two accessibility bugs: tab order skips the info 'i' tooltip and the chip is not keyboard operable. Also KMS label 'Managed key' reads like a link but is non-actionable and low contrast in light theme. Figma: https://figma.com/s/retention-panel-v4 :eyes:

sam: Agreed. Tooltip should be tabbable (tabindex=0) and the chip should be role=button with aria-expanded. Add visible focus ring.

robin: Copy nit: prefer 'Data retained for 90 days' in hover/expanded states. Keep '90d' for compact use. Backend audit strings must remain unchanged for now; ana, can you confirm?

ana: Confirmed. Audit events use stable keys. If product wants server-side text changes we need INF-2024 and a 2-release deprecation window. UI-only change is fine now.

sam: KMS badge: change text color for contrast (propose #0F1724) and make it plain status (role=status) with aria-label='encryption: managed'. If we later make it actionable, convert to a button.

robin: Sparkline SVG missing <title> and is focusable. Add <title>, role=img, and focusable=false so it doesn't trap keyboard users. Text for screen readers: 'Retention preview: default 90 days'.

maya: small QA note: some E2E tests assert exact 'Region: Auto' string. If we change UI to 'Region: Automatic (fallback)' we must coordinate tests. I'll file INF-2025.

deploy-bot: deploy queued for branch feature/retention-a11y-fix (sha: deadbee) :package:

maya: I'll send a PR with these UI changes only: tabbable tooltip, role=button chip, aria attributes, SVG title, and contrast tweak. Call out which bits need backend follow-up. PR by EOD and will request audit + security review.

ana: Thanks — I'll add audit reviewers and track the INF tickets.

robin: After PR lands please run an axe scan and a keyboard-only QA pass.

maya: Will do and will ping channel when CI passes.
